audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN / 6-10 is right at 50.00% over 2296 games; the phase shape was wrong.
audit.why: The lane is not flat — Garen owns levels 1-5 through Decisive Strike's silence and Courage's tenacity, Olaf owns 6, Garen reclaims at first item.
audit.corrected: Kept EVEN and re-anchored every phase why to the silence and the tenacity rather than to a generic 'pattern'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf while its own whys said Garen early, Olaf at 6, Garen at first item.
audit.why: The packet chart (Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Olaf/Garen/Skill) matches the existing why-text exactly, so the sides were the defect, not the prose.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group in both layers, sides to the packet chart and ratings to 4/4/4/4/6/4/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok described as 'cleanses'/'strips' Garen's silence, in tldr, winCon, whys[4] and spikes[1].
audit.why: Ragnarok grants immunity to disables for as long as he keeps attacking — it does not cleanse Garen's ability, it makes the silence irrelevant while you swing. Silence IS a disable, so the practical conclusion held; the mechanism was wrong.
audit.corrected: Restated as disable immunity that holds only while you keep attacking, with the 100/90/80s cost noted as a commit-only cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings give Olaf's W lifesteal ('W sustain', 'W-sustain', 'W for omnivamp sustain').
audit.why: Olaf's W is attack speed plus a SHIELD; the life steal is the passive and scales with MISSING health, which is why half-committing against Garen is worse than committing.
audit.corrected: W restated as Tough It Out's shield and attack speed; sustain moved to the missing-health passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing — Courage's tenacity claim is genuine and was worth keeping.
audit.why: Riot's Courage text explicitly gives a shield and TENACITY, then lesser damage reduction — that is what fights Undertow's slow, on a 22s cooldown at rank 1 falling to 12s.
audit.corrected: Kept, with the cooldown made concrete in winCon and breakdown.early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Ragnarok's disable immunity also ignores Decisive Strike's SLOW is not established.
audit.why: Riot's text says 'immune to disables', which does not settle slows either way, and the kit files carry no needsResearch entry for it.
audit.corrected: No slow-immunity claim made anywhere; every Ragnarok line is written around the silence only.

edits.before: Out-brawl him — R cleanses his silence, hit axes. Olaf wins by trading around Garen's Courage and cashing the pattern: out-brawl him; R cleanses his silence.
edits.after: Survive his Decisive Strike silence until 6 — Ragnarok makes his disables dead weight, then Undertow him, pick the axe up and Reckless Swing him down.

edits.before: Out-brawl him; R cleanses his silence. Track Courage before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Fight at 6 under Ragnarok, not before it. Track Courage's 22s cooldown and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Garen, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow him as he steps up, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing — Tough It Out shields his answer.

edits.before: Land the axe slow on Garen, walk the pickup for the reset, reave the true damage, and W-sustain whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Undertow him as he steps up, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing — Tough It Out shields his answer.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences your axe wind-up and his passive regen heals the poke back — take the CS, not the fight.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Respect Garen's Courage completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Garen wins first contact: Decisive Strike silences your cast and Courage's tenacity cuts the slow. Farm, hold Reckless Swing, and give up nothing you must bleed for.

edits.before: Level 6 flips to you — Ragnarok strips his silence and peel so you E-chunk and run him down past his W.
edits.after: Level 6 flips to you — Ragnarok's immunity holds while you swing, so his silence stops nothing you throw.

edits.before: Ragnarok is your one clean window — it strips his Q silence and any peel, so you ult, E true damage, and run him down before his R execute lands.
edits.after: Ragnarok is your one clean window: disable-immune while you keep attacking, so his silence does nothing — ult, Reckless Swing, run him down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still favour him short — his W tenacity and silence beat your axe-reset trade pattern. But Level 6 is yours: Ragnarok strips his Q silence and any peel he relies on, so you ult, W for omnivamp sustain, E him for the true-damage chunk, and Q-slow chase. That single window is your best chance to take a kill or pressure a plate before he reclaims at first item — his Stridebreaker/bruiser core and W tenacity let him disengage your slow again right after.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still favour him short — Courage's tenacity and the silence beat your axe-reset pattern. But Level 6 is yours: Ragnarok keeps you disable-immune as long as you keep swinging, so ult in, Tough It Out for the shield and attack speed, Reckless Swing for the true-damage chunk, and Undertow to chase. That window is your best chance at a kill or a plate before he reclaims at first item — Stridebreaker and Courage let him disengage your slow again right after.
